turns.question: What was our net revenue for orders placed in September 2026, meaning order amounts minus the amounts of their returns, excluding cancelled orders?
turns.answer: Net revenue (EUR) for September 2026 (2026-09-01 to 2026-09-30) was 12,582.75 EUR, using the one definition of net revenue, "Revenue minus partner returns (finance's net sales)": revenue of non-cancelled orders placed in September minus partner returns recorded in September (by return date, not only returns of September orders). Fresh: returns.silver is ready up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z. Late: sales.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
